physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Lagoon Nebula is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 21.95 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: Pinned common ICRS image-frame origin derived from registered observations; adopted display centre, not a measured nebular centroid. (https://github.com/layoutit/css.earth/blob/main/labs/nebula/models/m8/processing-observations.json); catalogue reference m8-registered-frame
sources.distance: Wright et al. (2019), The Gaia-ESO Survey: Asymmetric expansion of the Lagoon Nebula cluster NGC 6530 from GES and Gaia DR2 (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1903.12176v1); catalogue reference wright-2019-kinematics: 1326 pc (-69/+77); Adopted Gaia DR2 cluster distance from Wright et al. (2019), section 3.4: 1326 −69/+77 pc, including the stated parallax zero-point correction and systematic uncertainty. It is not an individual gas-cloud depth measurement.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: SIMBAD lists no radial velocity for M 8 (queried 2026-10-01); the nebula is held at its catalogued distance.
